title: Traffic export
description: Send one record per finished request to PostHog, an OpenTelemetry collector or your own endpoint. Delivery is queued off the request path and never slows or fails a request.

card.title: Export destinations
card.description: Records carry no visitor identity unless you opt in per destination.

notConfigured: Traffic export needs a master key to store destination credentials.

empty.title: No export destinations
empty.description: Add a destination to stream request records to your analytics tool.

row.testFailed: {{name}} did not accept the test record: {{reason}}

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: Its stored credentials are deleted and queued records are discarded.

sheet.description: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.tokenStored: A token is stored. Leave blank to keep it.
sheet.urlStored: A URL is stored. Leave blank to keep it.
sheet.authHeaderHint: Optional, for example Bearer followed by a token. Leave blank to keep the stored value.
sheet.fieldsHint: Every record already has the method, path, status, timings and request id. Nothing below is sent unless you tick it.
sheet.ipTruncateHint: Zero the last octet of an IPv4 address or the last 80 bits of an IPv6 address.
sheet.sampleHint: A number from 0 to 1. 1 exports every request.

referrer_host.label: Referrer host
referrer_host.hint: The site the request came from, host only.

visitor_id.label: Anonymous visitor id
visitor_id.hint: A daily-rotating hash of IP and user agent. Still counts as an identifier.

disclaimer.title: This destination will receive visitor identity
disclaimer.body: Client IP, user agent or visitor id can identify a person. Only enable them if your privacy notice covers sharing this data with the destination and you have a lawful basis. Cookies, auth headers, query strings and request bodies are never exported.

privacy: By default no client IP, user agent or visitor id is exported. Cookies, auth headers, query strings and request bodies are never exported.
